//Compile for the native CPU architecture (-march=native). Enables
// SSE4.1, SSSE3, AVX2, etc. on x86 and Apple Silicon tuning on
// ARM. Produces binaries that may not run on older CPUs.
ENABLE_NATIVE_ARCH:BOOL=ON

//Enable platform-specific optimizations that rely on hardware-defined
// behavior beyond what the C++ standard guarantees. When ON (default),
// the following techniques are used for performance: (1) Unaligned
// memory access — leaf nodes pack uint16_t offsets after variable-length
// byte arrays, producing addresses that may not be 2-byte aligned.
// On x86-64 and ARM64 this is handled transparently by hardware
// with no performance penalty. (2) Pointer arithmetic wraparound
// — the NEON branch-copy routine uses unsigned underflow (N-16
// when N<16) to compute a negative offset into caller-provided
// padding, avoiding a branch for the small-N case. (3) typed_int<uint16_t>
// is marked __attribute__((packed)) so the compiler knows these
// values may reside at any alignment. On a single-member struct
// this changes nothing about code generation on modern architectures.
// When OFF, all code paths use standards-conforming alternatives
// (memcpy for unaligned access, scalar fallbacks for small-N NEON).
// This is fully UBSAN-clean but measurably slower on hot paths.
// Use OFF when running sanitizers to get clean reports, or when
// targeting architectures where unaligned access traps (e.g. some
// MIPS, older ARM).
ENABLE_PLATFORM_OPTIMIZATIONS:BOOL=ON

//Enable Thread Sanitizer
ENABLE_SANITIZER:BOOL=OFF
